snippet.title: Red Stack - PC-8801 Gameplay
snippet.description:
This action game from Cosmos Computer is a pretty obscure game for the PC-8801. Not much about it is known other than the fact it came out in 1985 and it was a type-in game. The only other bit I know about it is that it was programmed by Ryo Ayase. I wonder if this person made any other games besides Red Stack. Let me know in the comments if you find any information about this game and Cosmos Computer.
